title: THALIA: Typed Harness with Analytical Lexical-Integrated Architecture
description: THALIA is an executable research harness for long-context memory systems. It combines typed stage contracts, inspectable context selection, evidence-preserving episodic state, lexical-first retrieval, and bounded compiler search with source-bound evaluation and reproducible artifact checks. Version 0.4.0 adds offline experiment planning, per-seed contrast auditing, coherent runtime composition and bound publication inputs without changing the historical measured study. Finite diagnostics do not establish expert model quality, integrity advantage or production readiness.
